'''LE-LU979''' was a female-[[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] [[LE-series repair droid]] nicknamed '''Lelu'''. She was talkative, and the coordinates for the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]'' were encrypted deep in her memory banks. Lelu was the [[Pilot/Legends|copilot]] aboard the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Spinster's Loom]]'' piloted by the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Brahtikka]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the pair piloted a team of operatives to the ''Shadow Raptor'', where they encountered a [[Shadow Raptor revolt|droid revolt]].

==Behind the scenes==
Brahtikka appears in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[roleplaying game]] [[2014]] adventure ''[[Dead in the Water]]'', written by [[Keith Kappel]].
